# AreaVibes

> > AreaVibes helps people find the best places to live across 50,000+ cities in the US and Canada using comprehensive Livability Scores and detailed community data.

AreaVibes is a location intelligence platform that combines livability metrics, crime rates, cost of living, demographics, and local insights to help users make informed decisions about where to relocate. The site features city guides, neighborhood comparisons, and curated top 10 lists for major metropolitan areas.

## Key Topics

- Livability Score
- Cost of Living
- Crime Rates
- City Rankings
- Neighborhood Comparison
- Area Guide
- Relocation Guide
- Demographics
- Real Estate
- Local Insights
- Best Places to Live
- City Comparison Tool
- USA
- Canada

## Core Tools & Features

- [Best Places to Live In the US & Canada](https://www.areavibes.com): AreaVibes homepage: explore 50,000+ cities with Livability Score
- [Compare Cities](https://www.areavibes.com/city-comparison): City comparison tool for US and Canada with Livability Scores

## Regional Guides

- [Best Places To Live In Canada 2026](https://www.areavibes.com/best-places/canada): Best Canadian cities and neighborhoods ranked by Livability Score
